title: SSRF guard allows any routable public IP; should restrict to tailnet range
description: peer_fetch.rs is_valid_fetch_host blocks loopback/RFC-1918/link-local but allows any routable IP. Design intent is fetching blobs only from tailnet peers (100.64.0.0/10 CGNAT or .ts.net hostnames). If mailbox_host in the DB ever points to a public IP (misconfiguration, future feature drift), fetch_peer_blob makes an outbound request to arbitrary public internet IPs. Fix: whitelist only 100.64.0.0/10 for numeric IPs and require .ts.net suffix for hostname-based hosts.
